fire: How many came to the party that night? All of them, I think.
Who ate the last slice of the pie? None of us did, I swear.
What was the outcome of the vote? Prices rose again.
We kept the files safe from harm. Additionally, we made a copy.
How many of your friends agree with that? Most of them, sadly.
How much of the money is left? Some of it, at least.
The tool saves time at every step. Additionally, it costs nothing.
Which of the roads are closed? Both of them, until the spring.
quiet: Many came to the party that night, and all of them stayed late.
The last slice of the pie went to the youngest of us at dinner.
The outcome of the vote came out on Monday, as prices rose again.
We kept the files safe from harm and made a copy on another disk.
Many of your friends agree with that, and they told me so sadly.
Much of the money is left in a box under the bed.
The tool saves time at every step and costs nothing at all.
Both of the roads are closed until the spring, the mayor said.
